plans.idea: Classic left-to-right banner read: large bottle anchors the left, the 'Glow.' headline with the single-line CTA tucked directly beneath it forms one message block, and the logo signs off at the right on the shared vertical centre.

Mirrored brand-first composition: logo lockup opens on the left, the headline and CTA sit as a centred stack in the middle as the clear focal point, and the bottle closes the frame on the right, balancing the weight symmetrically.

Headline-led three-column grid: oversized 'Glow.' leads on the left, the bottle sits centred as the visual pivot, and a right column groups the brand logo above the CTA so brand and action read as one sign-off block.
